verdict.rationale: Notion's own docs reference user-owned 'Custom Agents' that can be shared with connections and managed via the Agent APIs (status, credit limits, usage, chat sessions). Together with the '24/7 agents' marketing, this shows the product ships custom agents, but the evidence never describes how a user builds or configures one inside Notion. missing for 10: documentation of the in-product agent builder (instructions, tools, triggers, knowledge sources), hands-on or independent corroboration of creating and configuring an agent.
